t: What he said standing over a sick person
a: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
p: Adhhibi-l-baʾsa rabba-n-nās, ishfi wa anta-sh-shāfī, lā shifāʾa illā shifāʾuk, shifāʾan lā yughādiru saqamā
m: Take away the harm, Lord of people. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing. A healing that leaves no illness behind.
